correctness.rationale: Exact invertible change of variables reduces the collision system to the homogeneous degree-five polynomial F=sab(a²+b²+4s²), for odd p≠5. Finite-field strata have S_p simple nonzero zeros, D_p transverse double intersections, and the origin. Smooth classes lift by p^(2k−2), double classes by p^(2k−2)[1+(k−1)(p−1)], and the origin gives p^(3k−3) for k≤5 or p^12 E_(k−5) for k≥6. All cases cover every residue class without overlaps, including p=3. CRT proves global multiplicativity. The package verifier directly checks 17 local, 9 composite cases and 7 prime strata; all passed, and finite computations are not used as an unrestricted proof.

value.rationale: Ordered additive energy is the natural fourth-moment invariant of fifth-power polynomial graphs. The result determines it for every p-adic precision and every odd five-free composite modulus, with a nontrivial crossing-count arithmetic dichotomy and five-step singular-origin effect. It distinguishes finite fields of p^k elements from Z/p^k and goes beyond routine finite enumeration; exact fiber spectra and weighted sharp norms remain open here.
